summary: Overall quality is strong: the notebook is well-structured, runs end-to-end without errors, and uses a disciplined modeling workflow that reduces the risk of data leakage (all preprocessing is inside a pipeline fit only on the training split). The most important takeaway is that the model achieves a reasonable ranking performance (test ROC AUC ~0.729) but the candidate explicitly notes a practical limitation: recall is low at the default 0.5 threshold, which could miss many at-risk customers unless the threshold is tuned. In the interview, verify they can explain (in plain terms) how threshold calibration changes the recall/precision trade-off, and how they would validate the model over time (e.g., temporal validation) before deployment. Against the role requirements, the work appears to meet both “Rigorous methodology” and “Business-minded conclusions” very well.
